_description: CVE vulnerability-ranking experiment matrix (feature: cve-vulnerability-ranking). Each experiment resolves as base config + overrides; the runner (run_experiments.py) executes convert -> split -> Stage 1 -> Stage 2 -> predict -> evaluate and aggregates a cross-experiment summary. All experiments share split_seed for comparability; experiments with the same 'split' reuse one materialized split.

experiments.name: no-stage1 baseline
experiments.description: Honest reference: Stage 2 supervised heads over the FROZEN base sentence-transformer embeddings, with NO contrastive pretraining (no Stage 1). Any gain of E1..E5 over E0 is the value of ontology-supervised Stage 1.

experiments.name: baseline contrastive
experiments.description: Stage 1 with ontology-tiered negatives (hard/medium/easy pools) and NO sample weighting (ontology_weight=0). The default CVE pipeline.

experiments.name: label-completeness weighting
experiments.description: E1 + principled, ontology-INDEPENDENT sample weighting by label-completeness quality tier (ontology_weight=0.3, overlap off).

experiments.name: ontology-overlap weighting (ablation)
experiments.description: E2 + the self-referential ontology-overlap sample weight (ontology_weight=0.3, overlap on). Tests whether re-using the pairing signal as a weight helps or hurts vs E2.

experiments.name: hard-negative emphasis
experiments.description: E1 with a harder negative mix (tiers 0.7/0.2/0.1) to test whether emphasizing ontology-hard negatives sharpens the embedding.

experiments.name: temporal split
experiments.description: E1 configuration but a TEMPORAL split (train on older CVEs, test on newer) to measure generalization to future vulnerabilities rather than a random/stratified holdout.
